evidence.excerpt: Between 2016 and 2018 Ivković worked as a part-time machine learning consultant for a Novi Sad-based e-commerce startup, designing and evaluating their first collaborative filtering pipeline. He has subsequently maintained informal advisory relationships with two regional digital media companies whose anonymised datasets appear in several publications.
